result.reason: The redline adds the preferred 12-month software conformity warranty, appropriate remedies, and a professional-and-workmanlike services standard. However, it does not add a compliance-with-laws warranty, limits the malicious-code warranty to code that was “willfully introduced,” and does not state a 90-day preferred or 30-day fallback warranty period for services—the referenced 30 days is only a cure period. The services paragraph is also improperly placed after “The warranty shall not apply only if:,” leaving a dangling introduction and disrupting the clause structure. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language deficiencies.
